newsitem.title: USA: Winstar hires firm to help sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Winstar hires firm to help sell unit.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said on Wednesday that it has retained Southcoast Capital Corp to sell its consumer products unit, Global Products in order to permit the company to focus on its telecommunications core business.

Winstar said Global Products was a non-strategic asset it held before it entered telecommunications. The business's revenues were $3.7 million in the first quarter, and had been expected to reach approximately $25 million in 1997.
Several parties, including the unit's management, have expressed interest in acquiring Global Products, which makes and distributes bath and hair care products.
Southcoast will represent WinStar in evaluating these offers, and said that it is now treating Global Products as a discontinued operation, starting with the first quarter 1997.
"Its discontinuance will not affect WinStar's reported bottom line results," Winstar said in a statement.
The sale of the Global Products unit will allow WinStar to intensify its focus on its three core businesses: WinStar Telecom, WinStar Wireless and WinStar New Media.
